baseline_models.focus_anchor: The adjective rooted in خ ض د directly modifies the sidr noun inside the locative phrase.
baseline_models.mechanism: The modification removes or blunts the plant's injurious points while leaving the plant available for approach and contact.

activation_trace.role: This branch makes neutralization of thorns or sharpness the adjective's concrete operation on the sidr.

changed_reading.before: A place containing sidr described by an otherwise unresolved adjective.
changed_reading.after: A sidr whose dangerous contact points have been intentionally neutralized, making nearness safe.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The noun rooted in س د ر and its خ ض د adjective can both carry non-severing spatial movement.
baseline_models.mechanism: A hanging or trailing form combines with pliant bending that does not break apart, yielding a bowed living cover rather than damaged vegetation.

activation_trace.role: The branch's hanging-cloth or trailing-hair image supplies a draped spatial profile.
Pliant bending without complete fracture supplies the way that profile is formed.

changed_reading.before: Makhdud suggests vegetation that has simply been cut or damaged.
changed_reading.after: The sidr is supplely bowed and draped into cover while its continuity remains intact.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The س د ر inventory includes disturbed or veiled sight, while خ ض د includes loss of an edge.
baseline_models.mechanism: Visual sharpness and tactile sharpness are jointly reduced, so the phrase can register a softened sensory field as well as a botanical object.

activation_trace.role: The visual branch permits sidr to mark haze, weakened sight, or perceptual bewilderment.
The loss of a cutting edge extends softening from vision to bodily contact.

changed_reading.before: The phrase reports only a kind and condition of vegetation.
changed_reading.after: The phrase also evokes an environment in which glare, edges, and sensory harshness are subdued.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The adjective's خ ض د branches include handling, cutting, and eating moist tender material.
baseline_models.mechanism: Makhdud can profile the sidr as succulent and hand-harvestable, with tenderness rather than thorn-removal carrying the description.

activation_trace.role: The branch supplies the manual cutting of fresh, moist growth.
The eating branch makes tenderness and ready consumption part of the possible mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The adjective marks only safety from thorns.
changed_reading.after: The adjective may instead mark tender growth prepared for immediate hand-harvest and eating.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated companion-and-right frame turns physical de-thorning into hospitality: a protected cohort is given a setting whose points of injury have already been removed.

activation_trace.role: Removal of sharpness supplies the concrete preparation that makes the place hospitable.
Companionship identifies the setting with an abiding cohort rather than an isolated observer.
Blessedness assigns a favorable value to the cohort and its prepared environment.
Protective accompaniment at the list's return reinforces care as the environment's social function.
The right-side branch adds strength and entitlement to the cohort's relation to the provision.

structural_cues: 56:27 names the cohort before the landscape and 56:38 repeats the designation after the provision sequence, forming a social bracket.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies companionship, favor, protection, and de-thorning; I infer that the alteration serves the bracketed cohort. The live alternative is that the cohort label and plant condition are associated but not purposively linked.

changed_reading.before: A physically harmless tree stands as an unassigned scenic object.
changed_reading.after: The harmless sidr is prepared hospitality, a protected allotment fitted to the companions framed around it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The adjacent plant pair presents complementary operations: sharpness is subtracted from the sidr, while neighboring plant matter is joined into ordered density. Safety and fullness are designed together.

activation_trace.role: This supplies the subtractive operation: dangerous points are removed or blunted.
A second plant supplies the parallel material on which the neighboring operation acts.
Orderly joining supplies the additive operation, producing coherent abundance rather than clutter.

structural_cues: 56:28 and 56:29 are adjacent plant-plus-passive-adjective phrases, and the rhyming adjectives invite operational comparison.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies de-thorning, a second plant, and ordered joining; I infer a coordinated subtractive/additive design. The alternative is a catalogue of independent plant conditions with no shared production logic.

changed_reading.before: The sidr is a single tree made safe.
changed_reading.after: The sidr is one half of a curated system: harm is removed here while abundance is densely ordered beside it.

context_deltas.mechanism: Pliantly bowed, hanging sidr is activated as an overhead form; extended shade and delivered, pouring water then turn that form into a continuous shelter-and-flow environment.

activation_trace.role: The draping branch gives the sidr an overhanging profile capable of becoming cover.
Non-severing pliancy provides a way for the cover to bend into place without being destroyed.
The overhead-cover branch identifies the spatial result of the bowed vegetation.
Lengthening until connection turns local cover into an uninterrupted span.
Conveyed water supplies servicing and refreshment within the covered space.
Pouring supplies the downward motion that links the static canopy to active circulation.

structural_cues: The sequence 56:28-31 advances through similarly shaped indefinite noun-adjective units from vegetation to shade to water.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies pliant draping, overhead shade, extension, water delivery, and pouring; I infer that the sidr participates in one connected microenvironment. The alternative is that shade and water are independent amenities rather than effects or partners of the vegetation.

changed_reading.before: A supple sidr forms only a local botanical canopy.
changed_reading.after: The bowed sidr opens a continuous zone of overhead shelter and moving refreshment, functioning as environmental infrastructure.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus adjective's live possibility of cutting moist growth is checked by abundant fruit that is neither ended nor barred. The intervention becomes selective preparation: remove injury, preserve yield, and eliminate temporal and social obstruction.

activation_trace.role: Fresh cutting supplies the potentially destructive baseline that the later negations force into revision.
De-thorning supplies a selective intervention that can remove harm without ending productivity.
Edible fruit identifies yield as the material preserved by the intervention.
Numerical increase makes the preserved yield abundant rather than merely surviving.
Under negation, cessation and ending are explicitly excluded from the fruit's availability.
Under negation, a barrier between recipient and desired provision is also excluded.

structural_cues: Abundance in 56:32 is followed by the paired negation 'not ended and not withheld' in 56:33.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies moist cutting, de-thorning, abundant fruit, and two negated restrictions; I infer selective rather than destructive cultivation. The alternative is that the fruit clauses describe a separate item and do not constrain makhdud.

changed_reading.before: Makhdud may mean that tender growth has been cut or consumed.
changed_reading.after: Makhdud marks careful removal of harm without interruption of yield; provision remains plentiful, continuous, and unobstructed.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later creation and state-making reactivate the non-breaking خ ض د branch: the sidr's altered condition can be read as deliberate renewal into a pristine usable state, not mutilation.

activation_trace.role: Bending without complete fracture supplies continuity through alteration.
Fresh bringing-into-being supplies a restorative production process.
Transformation into a specified condition supplies deliberate state assignment.
Firstness supplies the pristine or newly begun endpoint of transformation.

structural_cues: 56:35 emphatically repeats the creation root, and 56:36 follows with a result-marking making clause.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies non-breaking alteration followed later by creation, making, and firstness; I infer a feedback analogy of restorative transformation. The live alternative is strong: the later feminine pronouns may govern a different referent, leaving no direct botanical remaking.

changed_reading.before: The sidr has undergone a merely subtractive cut or bend.
changed_reading.after: The sidr appears intentionally reconditioned into a pristine, usable form while its living continuity is preserved.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it crosses from botany into textiles and furnishing, but it remains anchored in the focus noun's draping branch and adjective's non-breaking bend, then gains spatial support from spread-and-raised furnishings. Render it only as an exploratory architectural resonance, not as a replacement lexical translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The س د ر noun can evoke hanging cloth, and the خ ض د adjective can evoke pliant bending without severance.

activation_trace.role: The draped-material image lets the vegetation outline a hanging enclosure.
Pliant shaping allows the enclosure to be formed without a broken frame.
Spreading and preparing a surface supplies the horizontal furnishing operation.
Elevation supplies the vertical operation that completes a furnished enclosure.

changed_reading.before: The focus depicts only vegetation occupying a place.
changed_reading.after: The sidr tentatively reads as draped spatial architecture, shaped into the upper fabric of a furnished habitat.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is a cross-domain transfer from physical de-thorning to social debarriering. It remains anchored in the focus operation and is activated by affection, peer equality, gathered groups, and the first/later pairing; downstream prose should call it a social analogy, never the direct sense of makhdud.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The خ ض د adjective supplies removal of an obstructive or injurious edge from the sidr.

activation_trace.role: Physical de-thorning provides the anchored operation later transferred analogically to social access.
Affection supplies a non-hostile relation among those inhabiting the prepared setting.
Peer equality supplies the leveling dimension of the social analogy.
The gathered-group branch scales access from individuals to a collective.
Beginning and precedence identify one temporal edge of the included collectives.
Succession supplies continuity from one collective to another rather than a closed first group.
Repetition of the gathered group confirms that collectivity exists on both temporal sides.
Laterness supplies the second temporal edge, extending the analogy beyond the first cohort.

changed_reading.before: De-thorning changes only the physical contact between a person and a plant.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the de-thorned sidr figures a hospitable field stripped of rank-like injury or exclusion for equal successive cohorts.

strongest_changes: The adjacent ordered plant turns de-thorning into the subtractive half of a coordinated design that adds density elsewhere.
Extended shade and poured water activate the pliantly bent sidr as part of a continuous shelter-and-flow environment.
Abundant fruit that is neither ended nor withheld revises cutting into selective harm-removal that preserves unrestricted yield.
The repeated companion-and-right frame recasts the prepared sidr as hospitality assigned to a protected cohort.
summary.what_was_special: The focus inventory offered no ordinary tree branch for س د ر, so its draping, perceptual, and movement images had to interact with the unusually concrete خ ض د operations. The neighboring passive-adjective sequence then exposed a production logic: bend without breaking, subtract danger, add order, extend cover, deliver water, and preserve access.
remaining_uncertainties: The shade, water, and fruit clauses may be independent catalogue items rather than effects or constraints on the focus vegetation.
The later creation-and-making sequence may concern a different referent, making its restorative feedback onto the sidr analogical only.
The perceptual, textile, and social readings are branch-anchored but remain more form-distant than the de-thorning model.
